title: Updating a coordinate of the value vector
statement:
For natural numbers $n,p,a,w,b,q,t,c,x,s,i,y,l,j,v$ and an index $r\in\{0,1,\ldots,13\}$, updating the value vector $(p,n,a,w,b,q,t,c,x,s,i,y,l,j)$ at coordinate $r$ to $v$ gives the vector whose entries, in order, are $p$ if $r
e0$ and $v$ otherwise; $n$ if $r
e1$ and $v$ otherwise; and, for each $k=2,\ldots,13$, the original entry at coordinate $k$ if $r
e k$ and $v$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is an index in the 14-coordinate vector
